verdict.rationale: Next.js's own docs describe a built-in MCP endpoint that gives coding agents access to a running Next.js app, so the framework itself ships an official MCP server agents can connect to. The evidence is a single docs-index summary line, so setup steps and the exposed tools are not shown. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of setup and the exposed MCP tools/capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Learn how to give coding agents access to your running Next.js app through the built-in MCP endpoint.
